responsibility: Implements Ddoc documentation generation from the front-end AST. It parses structured documentation comments into sections and macros, manages escape tables and macro expansion, emits formatted documentation for modules and members, highlights symbols, parameters, strings, comments, and code fragments using lexer-based tokenization, and produces the text transformations and anchors that drive generated D documentation output.
same_name_distinction: Holds the full Ddoc engine implementation—comment parsing, macro/escape processing, highlighting, and formatted emission—whereas `doc.h` is just the small public interface declaring the documentation entry points.
